index.description: AI-gile be a kanban board for AI coding crews. They toil while ye snore; ye get one short pile o' things to decide, test and accept.

f.pile.html: For ye holds everythin' waitin' on ye, across every project: questions, things to test, tasks only a human can do. Yer queue says what be next and how long it takes.
f.sleep.h: Crews that work while ye sleep
f.sleep.p: Each project has a captain and a crew o' AI agents. Comment on a card and the crew wakes, does the work, and hands it back with steps a weary landlubber can follow.
f.tester.p: Afore anythin' reaches ye, a tester follows the steps in a copy o' the app and shows what it saw, with a screenshot. Flick through the passed ones and accept in a click.
f.proof.p: Every hand-over shows what changed: the files, the diff, the screenshots. No openin' every app to see if it be done.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail: one icon per project, purple diamonds fer what needs ye. Message a captain an idea; they turn it into cards and a plan, with a ✅ Go button.
f.tidy.p: Related cards fold into one, muddled titles get fixed, and a token check keeps the code lean. Fewer things to switch between, less to ponder.
f.private.li1: The board sails on yer own machine and only answers to ye.
f.private.li2: Private DMs 'twixt people be end-to-end encrypted.
f.private.li3: No accounts, no trackers, no cookies.
f.lang.p: Over 120 tongues, from Dutch, Welsh and Japanese to pirate, Yoda and Klingon, with a quick swap back to English fer the industry jargon.
f.service.h: From an idea to a real service, arr
f.service.p: Built somethin' with AI that folk now use? Mark it as a service and the board helps ye run a tight ship: uptime checks, a public status page, storms with a write-up, changes that need a Go, backups checked daily. Help teaches each step as ye sail.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: yer crew in yer pocket
msgr.p1: Parley with yer AI crew without openin' the board. Chat with yer project captains an' yer mateys, an' see a card's test steps an' answer 'em, all from yer phone.
msgr.p2: To pair it, scan a QR code on yer board. First time aboard? A friendly demo chat shows ye the ropes.

msgr.b3: 1. Open Settings. 2. Pick Dark. Does it look shipshape?

privacy.title: AI-gile: what we stow
privacy.lede: Short version: only what ye send us, and not fer long.
privacy.only: Only what ye send us: what ye type into a form, like yer email. Nothin' else about ye.
privacy.sealed: It be sealed tight so our server can't read it: in yer browser afore it leaves port (on an older browser, the moment it makes land). Only our own board can crack it open.
privacy.server: It be scuttled from the server as soon as it reaches our board. Anythin' still there after 30 days gets scuttled anyway.
privacy.board: We keep it on our board only till we've replied to ye, then scuttle it there too.
privacy.none: No trackers, no cookies, no analytics, arr.
privacy.local: Yer tongue and yer light or dark sails stay in yer own browser. They never be sent to us.
privacy.ask: Want it gone sooner? Reply to our email and say so, matey.
